## Verification

List exact tests, checks, commands, or evidence.

## Risk

- [ ] Security-sensitive

## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, signing keys, keystores, or credentials are included.
- [ ] Third-party Actions/dependencies are pinned or integrity-controlled where practical.
- [ ] Required tests/checks pass.
